title: Port fixed-selection, clipped and robust cylinder fitting
scope: cylinder.ts radial/cylinderResidual, axisFromNormals, fitCylinderOnAxis, refineCylinderGeometric, fitCylinderClipped, cylinderFrom2 and ransacCylinder, plus circle2d.ts fitCircle2d and the linalg orthoBasis/projection helpers they use. splitTwoCylinders, fitCylinderFromSeed, region growing and the cylinder element/command shell are not in this unit.
acceptance: Original and Rust give bit-identical results (floats, used/inlier order, fitted/refused shape) on an independent corpus covering full and partial arcs, tilted axes, noise, outliers, offset coordinates, tiny and huge radii, planes, too few points, NaN and on-axis points; a wrong Rust value fails the comparison.
open_items: pinned_cylinder_comparison: 121/121 bit-identical against the pinned original (94 fitted, 7 refused, 20 refinements), corpus from fixtures/cylinder/generate.py, oracle oracle/cylinder.cjs. A wrong damping factor (0.3 -> 0.31) fails most fitted and refined cases.
Next for the cylinder element: splitTwoCylinders, fitCylinderFromSeed and the marked/seeded cylinder command through the engine and CLI (fit-cylinder).
Verification label and roster registration wait for the owner-scheduled milestone batch (2026-11-05 verification budget).
